parameters: frozen PLACO+ FI and FFS parameters; fixed unit-variance correlated Gaussian stress, not estimated from real samples
model: one trait mean mu in [0..6], other mean zero; both marginal variances 1; sample correlation fixed to fitted CorZ; exclude |Z| > sqrt(80) for either trait
method: product cutoff root via pinned official function; conditional 1D normal integration with both X and Y conditioning independently; symmetry and existing Monte Carlo comparison
limitation: per-marker stress probabilities, not empirical calibration, familywise error, real-data adjusted p-values, or estimates of true noncentrality
